title: StudentLink Ghana SHS, SHTS, STEM and TVET directory
sourceFile: Comprehensive Directory of SHS, SHTS, STEM, and TVET Institutions in Ghana supplied for StudentLink
directoryPolicy: The supplied directory is the authoritative display-name list. Names are stored in alphabetical order. Profiles may retain legacy spellings, which are mapped conservatively to these canonical display names.

sources.title: User-supplied Comprehensive Directory of SHS, SHTS, STEM, and TVET Institutions in Ghana
sources.note: Primary school-name source for StudentLink selection and school grouping.

completenessNote: This list mirrors the supplied directory; inclusion is not independent verification of each institution's current status.
normalizationPolicy: Exact normalized names and explicit aliases canonicalize immediately. Legacy names are mapped only when the match is strong, unique, and consistent with school type/campus; ambiguous schools remain separate.
